prompt: I want to build a roguelike dungeon crawler — procedurally generated dungeons, turn-based combat, pixel art. PC only. The player picks a class at the start (Warrior, Rogue, or Mage), finds items and equipment in dungeons, and fights through floors with a boss every 5 levels. Permadeath but with meta-progression unlocks between runs. Please create a full PRD for this game.
